tools.name: takeLane_functions_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the TakeLane class from the Live Object Model API documentation.

takeLane.description: object ID or canonical path of the take lane

summary.description: This class represents a take lane in Live. Tracks in Live can have take lanes in Arrangement View, which are used for comping. If take lanes exist for a track, they can be shown by right-clicking on a track and choosing Show Take Lanes. Canonical path: live_set tracks N take_lanes M

tools.name: takeLane_children_get_arrangementClips
tools.description: Get the list of this take lane's Arrangement View clip IDs.

takeLane.description: object ID or canonical path of the take lane

tools.name: takeLane_properties_get_name
tools.description: Get the name as shown in the take lane header.

takeLane.description: object ID or canonical path of the take lane

name.description: name as shown in the take lane header

tools.name: takeLane_functions_createAudioClip
tools.description: Create an audio clip referencing a file in the arrangement view at the specified start time.

takeLane.description: object ID or canonical path of the take lane

filePath.description: absolute path to a valid audio file in a supported format

startTime.description: start time in beats (must be within range [0., 1576800])

success.description: whether the audio clip was created successfully

tools.name: takeLane_functions_createMidiClip
tools.description: Create an empty MIDI clip with the specified length and insert it into the arrangement at the specified start time.

takeLane.description: object ID or canonical path of the take lane

startTime.description: start time in beats (must be within range [0., 1576800])

length.description: length of the clip in beats

success.description: whether the MIDI clip was created successfully
